# gcore_dns_zones (Data Source)

DNS zones are authoritative containers for domain name records, with support for DNSSEC and SOA configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_dns_zones" "example_dns_zones" {
  id = [0]
  case_sensitive = true
  client_id = [0]
  dynamic = true
  enabled = true
  exact_match = true
  healthcheck = true
  iam_reseller_id = [0]
  name = ["string"]
  order_by = "order_by"
  order_direction = "asc"
  reseller_id = [0]
  status = "status"
  updated_at_from = "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z"
  updated_at_to = "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `case_sensitive` (Boolean)
- `client_id` (List of Number) to pass several `client_ids` `client_id=1&client_id=3&client_id=5...`
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Zones with dynamic RRsets
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `exact_match` (Boolean)
- `healthcheck` (Boolean) Zones with RRsets that have healthchecks
- `iam_reseller_id` (List of Number)
- `id` (List of Number) to pass several ids `id=1&id=3&id=5...`
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `name` (List of String) to pass several names `name=first&name=second...`
- `order_by` (String) Field name to sort by
- `order_direction` (String) Ascending or descending order
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `reseller_id` (List of Number)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at_from` (String)
- `updated_at_to` (String)

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (Number)
- `contact` (String) email address of the administrator responsible for this zone
- `dnssec_enabled` (Boolean) describe dnssec status
true means dnssec is enabled for the zone
false means dnssec is disabled for the zone
- `dnssec_status` (String) `dnssec_status` is the four-state lifecycle status of DNSSEC for the zone, driven by the
parent-DS scan against the registrar. One of: pending, active, pending-disabled, disabled.
Empty when DNSSEC has never been enabled for the zone.
- `dnssec_status_modified_on` (String) `dnssec_status_modified_on` is the RFC3339 timestamp of the last `dnssec_status` change.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `expiry` (Number) number of seconds after which secondary name servers should stop answering request for this zone
- `id` (Number) ID of zone.
This field usually is omitted in response and available only in
case of getting deleted zones by admin.
- `meta` (Map of String) arbitrarily data of zone in json format
- `name` (String) name of DNS zone
- `nx_ttl` (Number) Time To Live of cache
- `primary_server` (String) primary master name server for zone
- `records` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--records))
- `refresh` (Number) number of seconds after which secondary name servers should query the master for the SOA record, to detect zone changes.
- `retry` (Number) number of seconds after which secondary name servers should retry to request the serial number
- `rrsets_amount` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--rrsets_amount))
- `serial` (Number) Serial number for this zone or Timestamp of zone modification moment.
If a secondary name server slaved to this one observes an increase in this number,
the slave will assume that the zone has been updated and initiate a zone transfer.
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `short_answers` (List of String)
- `ttl` (Number)
- `type` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--items--rrsets_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.rrsets_amount`

Read-Only:

- `dynamic` (Attributes) Amount of dynamic RRsets in zone (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--rrsets_amount--dynamic))
- `static` (Number) Amount of static RRsets in zone
- `total` (Number) Total amount of RRsets in zone

<a id="nestedatt--items--rrsets_amount--dynamic"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.rrsets_amount.dynamic`

Read-Only:

- `healthcheck` (Number) Amount of RRsets with enabled healthchecks
- `total` (Number) Total amount of dynamic RRsets in zone
